name: Villanueva de Teba (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally yellow over blue with a red hoist stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de Teba (a castle on red and ears of wheat on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de Teba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva de Teba arms — castle and ears of wheat
